fixed_in: File.basename with the ".*" suffix treats a leading run of dots as part of the name (2026-11-07)
note: The prelude's ".*" branch scanned back to the last dot anywhere in the basename, so `File.basename("..", ".*")` answered "." where CRuby answers ".."; the same wrong answer appeared for "...", "..foo" and any other name whose only dot is in the leading run. The fix mirrors CRuby's `ruby_enc_find_basename`: skip the leading dots, then strip from the last dot after them. Compared with CRuby 4.0.5.
